question: Extract the explicitly described future-state capabilities, target operating model, expected behavior, or desired end state.

capabilities: The solution shall notify relevant users when an application is assigned, returned, approved, rejected, conditionally approved, overdue or completed.
Authorized users shall be able to view application stage, responsible owner, outstanding conditions, aging and next action.
The solution shall maintain an immutable history of application submissions, financial-data changes, document actions, credit decisions, conditions and status transitions.
Users shall be able to search loan applications and generate standard reports by status, product, borrower type, risk class, age and owning team.
The solution shall place an application on hold when mandatory information is missing, a validation fails or an approval condition remains unresolved, and shall record the reason.
